summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Loma Negra Compania Industrial Argentina Sociedad Anonima, a foreign private issuer, reporting its 1Q26 earnings results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard financial highlights including net revenue of Ps. 218,739 million, adjusted EBITDA of Ps. 54,566 million, and net profit of Ps. 40,627 million. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. CEO Sergio Faifman provides only routine commentary on operational performance and market outlook.
